cool.root_cause: The agent fails to locate the mug, spending many steps wandering through stoves and sinkbasin instead of searching cabinets or fridge where mugs are commonly found.
cool.evidence: After many steps, it still hasn't picked up any mug; it only sees a cup on countertop 2 but ignores it.
cool.corrective_rule: If the target object is not visible in the initial area, systematically search all storage locations (cabinets, fridge, drawers) before exploring non-storage areas.
cool.skill_tree_gap: Lacks a prioritized search strategy for target objects.
